subject: Oceanography
title: Dissolved Gases
description: A quick win: understand Dissolved Gases.

hook.text: Fish breathe oxygen dissolved in seawater—but the ocean holds 50 times less oxygen than air.

buildup.text: Oxygen enters the ocean at the surface through wave mixing and photosynthesis by phytoplankton.

discovery.text: CO₂ also dissolves in seawater, where it forms carbonic acid—making the ocean slightly acidic.

twist.text: Some ocean depths have almost zero oxygen—'dead zones' where most animals cannot survive.

climax.text: The balance of dissolved gases controls where marine life can thrive and where it can't.

punchline.text: Even underwater, breathing depends on the atmosphere above.

quiz.question: How does oxygen enter the ocean?
options: Through wave mixing and phytoplankton photosynthesis
